title: U.S. FDA issues seven observations to Dr. Reddy’s biologics manufacturing facility in Hyderabad
summary: The company cited two previous inspections of the facility in October 2023 and September 2025 when the U.S. FDA had issued a Form 483 each with nine and five observations respectively
